definitions.explanation: A wheeled conveyance, especially in formal or technical contexts.
An individual car of a train.

notes:
{車両|しゃりょう} is a formal or technical term for vehicles. In everyday speech, ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ is used for cars and ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ for trains, while {車両|しゃりょう} appears in official signs, regulations, and announcements.

TRAIN USAGE:
- ⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧{車両|しゃりょう}: front car
- ⟦{最後尾|さいこうび}→最後尾：21693_saikoubi⟧{車両|しゃりょう}: rear car
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧{車両|しゃりょう}: women-only car
- ～⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}→編成：20615_hensei⟧: N-car formation (e.g., 10⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}→編成：20615_hensei⟧)

ROAD/REGULATION USAGE:
- {車両|しゃりょう}⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no vehicles allowed
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{車両|しゃりょう}: emergency vehicle
- {車両|しゃりょう}⟦{進入|しんにゅう}→進入：14547_shinnyuu⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no vehicle entry
